ModMetaData.name: Goblins Don't Deserve Geneva Convention
ModMetaData.author: Local source draft
ModMetaData.description:
Version 0.2.4 source draft.
Adds the Goblin Exceptionalism meme. The included Harmony source is designed to suppress moral mood memories only when both conditions are true: the receiving pawn follows an ideology containing this meme, and the affected victim or food is an MUGB goblin/hobgoblin. Human, baseliner, HAR, Maru, Miho, Ratkin, Dragonian, and other humanlike targets remain governed by their original cannibalism, execution, organ-harvesting, charity, and related precepts.
This archive does not contain a compiled DLL. No global ThoughtDef mood values or MUGB pheromone definitions are modified by XML. It adds instance-aware special corpse filters so MUGB goblin/hobgoblin corpses can be selected separately from other humanlike corpses in bill filters.
